title: 8 Home themes
text: Light, Dark, Nature, Minimal, Ocean, Sunset, Forest and Aurora backgrounds, picked in Home screen settings next to the new Auto refresh dropdown (10 seconds up to once a day). Home also has a switch to hide the Apps box.

title: Delivery Tracker keeps itself live
text: It refreshes quietly on your chosen gap without losing your place or what you are typing.

title: Sheets in their own window
text: Label Log, Delivery Tracker and Gmail open in a clean Chrome window with no tabs or address bar, already signed in.

title: Bigger updates without reinstalling
text: From now on the program's core can also update through Update now.
